description_en: Triggers a job to run immediately
description_zh: 触发一次任务立即运行
kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx2 execute-job --job-id 92583 --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecuteJob

parameters.help_en: The job ID. You can obtain the ID on the Task Management page in the console
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，在控制台的任务管理页面中获取
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The parameters carried by this trigger. The value can be any string. The `processor` code retrieves the value by calling `context.getInstanceParameters()`. This is different from the custom parameters specified when you create a job
parameters.help_zh: 本次触发携带参数，可以是任意字符串，`processor`代码通过`context.getInstanceParameters()`获取，区别于创建任务自定义参数
parameters.name: instance_parameters

parameters.help_en: The namespace ID. You can obtain the ID on the Namespace page in the console
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: Required only for special third-party use
parameters.help_zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
parameters.name: namespace_source

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can obtain the ID on the Application Management page in the console
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to check the job status. Valid values: true: The job can be executed only when it is enabled. false: The job can be executed even when it is not enabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否检查任务状态，取值如下：true：任务启用才能执行任务。false：任务不启用也可以执行任务
parameters.name: check_job_status

parameters.help_en: The type of the designated machine. Valid values: 1: designate a worker. 2: designate a label
parameters.help_zh: 指定机器的类型，取值如下：1：指定worker。2：指定label
parameters.name: designate_type

parameters.help_en: The worker address of the application. Obtain the workerAddress by calling the GetWokerList operation first
parameters.help_zh: 应用的worker地址，需要先通过GetWokerList接口返回workerAddress
parameters.name: worker

Data.description_en: The job instance ID. This parameter is returned only if the job is triggered successfully
Data.description_zh: 如果成功，会返回任务实例ID

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned only if an error occurs
Message.description_zh: 错误消息，仅出错时返回错误信息
Message.example: groupid not exist groupId: testSchedulerx.defaultGroup namespace: adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc****

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the job was triggered successfully. Valid values:

`true`: The job was triggered successfully.
`false`: The job failed to be triggered
Success.description_zh:
触发任务是否成功。取值如下：

`true`：触发任务成功。
`false`：触发任务失败
